select table_name, column_name, data_type, udt_schema, udt_name,
       is_nullable, column_default
from information_schema.columns
where table_schema = 'public'
  and (table_name in ('api_keys', 'api_limits', 'api_logs', 'api_usage_logs', 'api_usage', 'usage_logs')
       or table_name like '%api%key%' or table_name like '%usage%')
order by table_name, ordinal_position

select c.relname as table_name, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity,
       pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) as owner, c.relacl
from pg_catalog.pg_class c
join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind in ('r', 'p', 'v')
  and (c.relname in ('api_keys', 'api_limits', 'api_logs') or c.relname like '%api%key%' or c.relname like '%usage%')
order by c.relname

  and (tablename in ('api_keys', 'api_limits', 'api_logs') or tablename like '%api%key%' or tablename like '%usage%')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_category_usage(category_name text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.categories
  SET usage_count = usage_count + 1
  WHERE name = category_name AND is_active = true;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_user_stats_on_signup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.user_stats (user_id)
  VALUES (NEW.id)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_repository_stats(repo_name text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  result JSON;
BEGIN
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'total_bookmarks', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_bookmarks WHERE repo_full_name = repo_name),
    'total_votes', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_votes WHERE repo_full_name = repo_name),
    'average_rating', (SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) FROM repository_votes WHERE repo_full_name = repo_name),
    'total_comments', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_comments WHERE repo_full_name = repo_name AND parent_comment_id IS NULL),
    'total_shares', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_shares WHERE repo_full_name = repo_name)
  ) INTO result;
  
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_activity_heatmap(p_user_id uuid, p_days integer DEFAULT 365)
 RETURNS TABLE(activity_date date, total_count integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT 
    activity_date,
    SUM(activity_count)::INTEGER as total_count
  FROM public.activity_logs
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    AND activity_date >= CURRENT_DATE - p_days
  GROUP BY activity_date
  ORDER BY activity_date;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, full_name, avatar_url)
  VALUES (NEW.id, NEW.email, NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url');
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_user_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.profiles SET email = NEW.email, full_name = NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', 
  avatar_url = NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = NEW.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_category_usage(category_name text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.categories
  SET usage_count = usage_count + 1
  WHERE name = category_name AND is_active = true;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_platform_stat(key text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.platform_stats 
  SET stat_value = stat_value + 1,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE stat_key = key;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_trending_data_stale()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM trending_repos
    WHERE fetched_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
    LIMIT 1
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_user_activity(p_user_id uuid, p_activity_type text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() then
    raise exception 'activity can only be logged for the signed-in user'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  insert into public.activity_logs as logs
    (user_id, activity_type, activity_date, activity_count, metadata)
  values (p_user_id, p_activity_type, current_date, 1, p_metadata)
  on conflict (user_id, activity_type, activity_date)
  do update set
    activity_count = logs.activity_count + 1,
    metadata = p_metadata,
    updated_at = now();
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_repo_embeddings(query_embedding vector, match_count integer, match_offset integer DEFAULT 0, min_similarity double precision DEFAULT 0.2, filter_language text DEFAULT NULL::text, min_stars integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(repo_id bigint, repo_full_name text, description text, html_url text, clone_url text, language text, topics text[], license jsonb, stargazers_count integer, forks_count integer, updated_at timestamp with time zone, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select
    repo_id,
    repo_full_name,
    description,
    html_url,
    clone_url,
    language,
    topics,
    license,
    stargazers_count,
    forks_count,
    updated_at,
    1 - (embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity
  from public.repo_embeddings
  where (filter_language is null or language ilike filter_language)
    and (min_stars is null or stargazers_count >= min_stars)
    and (1 - (embedding <=> query_embedding)) >= min_similarity
  order by embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count offset match_offset;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_conversation_message_count()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.total_messages = jsonb_array_length(NEW.messages); NEW.last_message_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_conversation_updated_at()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN NEW.updated_at = NOW(); RETURN NEW; END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.upsert_shared_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid, p_is_public boolean, p_title text, p_summary text, p_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS shared_conversations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_share public.shared_conversations;
BEGIN
  -- Try update existing share (owned by caller)
  UPDATE public.shared_conversations
  SET is_public = COALESCE(p_is_public, is_public),
      title = COALESCE(p_title, title),
      summary = COALESCE(p_summary, summary),
      snapshot = COALESCE(p_snapshot, snapshot),
      deleted_at = NULL
  WHERE conversation_id = p_conversation_id AND created_by = auth.uid()
  RETURNING * INTO v_share;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    INSERT INTO public.shared_conversations(
      conversation_id, created_by, is_public, title, summary, snapshot
    ) VALUES (
  p_conversation_id, auth.uid(), COALESCE(p_is_public, TRUE), p_title, p_summary, COALESCE(p_snapshot, jsonb_build_array())
    ) RETURNING * INTO v_share;
  END IF;

  RETURN v_share;
END;
$function$
